3.0.1.en:
Responsive design of the configuration according to the ioBroker responsive design initiative (cards instead of the table on narrow screens)
New admin tab in React (replaces jsonTab)
Fix reading of latitude/longitude from the system settings (js-controller 7)
Fix crash when no coordinates are configured
Skip the astro calculation when latitude/longitude are missing or invalid
Admin configuration migrated from materialize to jsonConfig (custom React components for the shutter table and the shutter dialog)
Accept latitude/longitude with a decimal comma
Fix the delay of the complete down drive after the intermediate position
Fix the check of the public holiday instance
Backend migrated to TypeScript (src/ → build/)
Use adapter.delay() and adapter.setTimeout() instead of custom sleep functions and plain timers
Fix overlapping runs (e.g. sun protection, alarms, buttons) cancelling each other's wait, which skipped shutters
Fix start-up checks of the control states and the initial brightness state
Cancel the brightness down job on unload
Unused translation helper (axios) removed
i18n files migrated to the short format ({lang}.json)
tsconfig.json added
